title: Token-wise Mirror modulation generator
hypothesis: A shared frozen feature block with a token-position-generated 8-angle Givens View can represent held-out token-dependent transforms with lower payload bytes and error than token-wise FiLM, while the full-affine generator provides a higher-cost control.
physical_object: One shared frozen nonlinear 16D feature block applied at every token.
mirror_coordinate: Eight rotation angles generated as affine functions of scalar token position p; 16 generator coefficients total.
logical_multiplicity: A continuum of token-specific logical feature transforms from one shared feature block.
controls: token-wise affine FiLM generator: scale and bias each affine in p (64 coefficients)
token-wise rank-one residual with u(p),v(p) affine in p (64 coefficients)
full-affine generator: matrix and bias affine in p (544 coefficients)

task.target: For each token, apply a product of eight adjacent-pair Givens rotations with angle_j(p)=intercept_j+slope_j*p to the shared frozen nonlinear feature vector.

development.selection_metric: held-out-position normalized RMSE; all methods use same token positions and inputs.

storage.format: deterministic NPZ with FP16 weights/coefficients plus UTF-8 metadata
paid_objects: all conditional generator coefficients or residual factors

compute.measurement: Eager CPU single-thread; 10 warmup and 25 timed calls on batch 1024; include code generation and transform.

success_gate: Both development seeds: Mirror held-out NRMSE <=0.02 and <=0.10x token-wise FiLM NRMSE; payload <=0.75x token-wise FiLM and <=0.10x full-affine generator; throughput >=0.80x token-wise FiLM. Pass qualifies only for fresh confirmation.
failure_gate: FAIL if any full success gate criterion is missed in either seed, or if global/token-wise FiLM matches quality within 5% at byte ratio <=1.10.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism screen only; no natural language or Transformer claim.
Held-out positions test extrapolation, not random interpolation.
The teacher is structured to vary smoothly with token position; no arbitrary token-wise function capacity claim.
Fresh remains sealed unless both development seeds pass.
